name: Shopify connector (Shopify Setup MCP)
description: Creates and manages Shopify stores, products, orders, inventory and analytics from chat via Shopify's hosted MCP; works only in ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, for merchants.

skills.name: Create a Store
skills.description: Creates a Shopify store preview from a description of your business, then helps you save it to a Shopify account you own.

skills.name: Products and Collections
skills.description: Searches, creates and updates products and collections, including prices, descriptions and bulk status changes, in your store.

skills.name: Orders and Customers
skills.description: Lists and retrieves orders and customers from the connected store, within the data access you approve in Shopify admin.

skills.name: Inventory and Discounts
skills.description: Inspects inventory levels, sets quantities and creates percentage discount codes for the connected Shopify store.

skills.name: Store Analytics
skills.description: Runs ShopifyQL queries for sales, order and product-performance analysis on the connected Shopify store.
